prompt: Complete OrderTicketArchive so pack writes a List of Ticket records to a byte array and unpack reads the list back with its order intact.
explanation: A record can be serialized as soon as it declares implements Serializable, and ArrayList is serializable too, so one writeObject call stores the whole list. Because a List is an ordered collection, deserialization rebuilds it element by element in the original order -- nothing extra is needed to preserve it. Copying into a new ArrayList before writing guards against list views such as List.of or subList that may not be serializable.
hints: Serialize into a ByteArrayOutputStream, then return its toByteArray().
readObject returns Object; cast it to List<Ticket> -- the @SuppressWarnings annotation is already there for that cast.
Close the ObjectOutputStream (or use try-with-resources) before calling toByteArray, or the stream may not be flushed.
